Flipcraft
Tiny voxel sandbox for
Flipper Zero.

World controls:
Up/Down - walk
Left/Right - turn
OK + Up/Down - look
OK + Left/Right - hotbar
OK short - place / use /
  attack creature
OK long - mine / tame wolf
Back short - jump
Back long - inventory
OK + Back - quit

Menus:
Arrows - cursor
OK - pick / place / craft
OK + arrow - drop one
Back - close

by @apfxtech
